D-PHY Error Scenerios, Physical layer cover point: coverpoint hs_clk_exception_seq_lp11_01_10_11_normal_cp -- Clock lane HS clk exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> HS-Rqst(LP-01) -> LP10 -> Stop(LP11)} coverpoint hs_clk_exception_seq_lp11_01_11_normal_cp -- Clock lane HS clk exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> HS-Rqst(LP-01) -> Stop(LP11)} coverpoint ulps_clk_exception_seq_lp11_10_01_11_normal_cp -- Clock ULPS exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> ULPS-Enter(LP-10) -> LP01 -> LP11} coverpoint ulps_clk_exception_seq_lp11_10_11_normal_cp -- Clock ULPS exception sequence: {Stop(LP-11) -> ULPS-Enter(LP-10) -> LP11}  
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage  covergroup  svt_mipi_dphy_clock_global_timing_parameter_cg  svt_mipi_dphy_clock_global_timing_parameter_cg covergroup definition.
D-PHY Cover Group for Clock Global Timing Parameter Coverage. coverpoint t_clk_prepare_cp -- Clock T_CLK_PREPARE global timing parameter will be covered when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_PREPARE is equal to time that the transmitter drives the Clock Lane LP-00 Line state immediately before the HS-0 Line state starting the HS transmission. coverpoint t_clk_trail_cp -- Clock T_CLK_TRAIL global timing parameter will be covered when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_TRAIL is equal to the time the transmitter drives the flipped differential state after last payload data bit of a HS transmission burst i.e T hs_trail_value coverpoint t_clk_prepare_clk_zero_cp -- Clock T_CLK_PREPARE_CLK_ZERO global timing parameter will be hit coverage when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_HS_PREPARE_T_HS_GO is the combination of HS_PREPARE time and HS_GO time. Coverage will be hit only in HS mode of transmission. It is not same as SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_PREPARE_CLK coverpoint t_ulps_wakeup_cp -- Clock T_ULPS_WAKEUP global timing parameter will get hit when value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_CLOCK_T_ULPS_WAKEUP is equal to the time for which the transmitter drives a Mark-1 state prior to a Stop state (LP11) in order to initiate an exit from ULPS. coverpoint clock_rate_range_supported_cp -- Clock rate Range Supported coverpoint will get hit on the basis of lane configuration field DPHY_UI value
Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories. cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clk_prepare -- Clock rate range and T_CLK_PREPARE cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clk_trail -- Clock rate range and T_CLK_TRAIL cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clk_prepare_clk_zero -- Clock rate range and T_CLK_PREPARE_CLK_ZERO cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_ulps_wakeup -- Clock rate range and T_ULPS_WAKEUP cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clock_post -- Clock rate range and T_CLOCK_POST cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_clock_pre -- Clock rate range and T_CLOCK_PRE  
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage  covergroup  svt_mipi_dphy_clock_lane_cg  svt_mipi_dphy_clock_lane_cg covergroup definition.
DSI Physical layer cover point: coverpoint clock_lane_hs_normal_seq_cp -- Clock lane HS normal sequence(state machine sequence) coverpoint clock_lane_ulps_normal_seq_cp -- Clock lane ULPS normal sequence(state machine sequence) coverpoint clock_behaviour_cp -- Clock behaviour:{Non-continuous, continuous}  
 svt_mipi_dsi_coverage  covergroup  svt_mipi_dphy_data_global_timing_parameter_cg  svt_mipi_dphy_data_global_timing_parameter_cg covergroup definition.
D-PHY Cover Group for Data Global Timing Parameter Coverage. coverpoint t_hs_prepare_cp -- Data T_HS_PREPARE global timing parameter will be covered when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_PREPARE is equal to the time that the transmitter drives the Data Lane LP-00 Line state immediately before the HS-0 Line state starting the HS transmission. coverpoint t_hs_prepare_hs_zero_cp -- Data T_HS_PREPARE_T_HS_ZERO global timing parameter will be covered when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_PREPARE_T_HS_ZERO is equal to the time THS-PREPARE + time that the transmitter drives the HS-0 state prior to transmitting the Sync sequence. coverpoint t_hs_trail_cp -- Data T_HS_TRAIL global timing parameter will be covered when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_HS_TRAIL is equal to the time the transmitter drives the flipped differential state after last payload data bit of a HS transmission burst i.e T hs_trail_value coverpoint t_int_slave_cp -- Data T_INIT_SLAVE global timing parameter will get hit if the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_INIT is equal to the time taken by the master to drive Stop state (LP11) for a period greater than T_init time i.e initialization time. coverpoint t_lpx_cp -- Data T_LPX global timing parameter will get hit when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_LP_REQUEST is equal to ULPS request time, where ULPS request time is equal to T LPX. coverpoint t_ta_get_ta_sure_cp -- Data T_TA_GET_TA_SURE global timing parameter will get hit when the value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_TA_WAIT is equal to Ta_wait_time which in turn equal to Ta_sure_time according to the specification. This coverpoint will be covered based on the value of Ta_sure_time as defined in timing file. coverpoint t_wake_up_cp -- Data T_WAKEUP global timing parameter will get hit when value of SVT_MIPI_DPHY_T_WAKEUP is equal to the time for which the transmitter drives a Mark-1 state prior to a Stop state (LP11) in order to initiate an exit from Escape state coverpoint clock_rate_range_supported_cp -- Clock rate Range Supported coverpoint will get hit on the basis of lane configuration field DPHY_UI value
Crosses:
Crosses are defined by crossing one or more of the coverpoints in the above categories. cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_hs_prepare -- Clock rate range and T_HS_PREPARE cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_hs_prepare_hs_zero -- Clock rate range and T_HS_PREPARE_HS_ZERO cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_hs_trail -- Clock rate range and T_HS_TRAIL cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_int_slave -- Clock rate range and T_INIT_SLAVE cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_lpx -- Clock rate range and T_Lpx cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_ta_get_ta_sure -- Clock rate range and T_TA_GET_TA_SURE cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_wake_up_cp -- Clock rate range and T_WAKE_UP cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_hs_exit -- Clock rate range and T_HS_EXIT cross clock_rate_range_supported_vs_t_ta_go -- Clock rate range and T_TA_GO
